questions.title: Advertisement
questions.question_text: Do you often see advertisements when you are on your phone or computer?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: Yes, they are practically everywhere online. Social media platforms constantly show me targeted advertisements based on what I search for or watch. Most of the time I skip them, but an eye-catching one can still grab my attention.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Advertisement
questions.question_text: Is there an advertisement that made an impression on you when you were a child?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: Yes, the NaoBaiJin commercial is still deeply rooted in my mind. Its animated elderly couple danced to a catchy jingle that appeared on television every holiday. It was repetitive and slightly annoying, but that is exactly why it made such a lasting impression.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Advertisement
questions.question_text: Do you see a lot of advertising on trains or other transport?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: Yes, public transport is packed with commercial messages. I see posters inside train carriages, videos on station screens and even full-body bus adverts. Since commuters are a captive audience, companies clearly see transport as valuable advertising space.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Advertisement
questions.question_text: Do you like advertisements?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: I have mixed feelings about them. Creative adverts can be entertaining and introduce me to products that are genuinely useful and relevant. However, repetitive pop-ups really get under my skin, especially when they interrupt a video.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Advertisement
questions.question_text: What kind of advertising do you like?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: I prefer short adverts that tell a clear and relatable story. A clever visual or catchy slogan can make a brand stand out from the crowd without wasting my time. I also appreciate adverts with a social message, such as encouraging recycling or road safety.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Art
questions.question_text: Do you like art?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: It depends on the form of art, to be honest. Visual arts like painting and sculpture aren't really my cup of tea, mostly because I struggle to understand the meaning behind them. But I'm a big fan of performing arts such as musicals and theatre, and I always get carried away when I watch a live show.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Art
questions.question_text: Do you like visiting art galleries?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: Not really, I wouldn't say art galleries are my thing. I did visit one last winter that was just a stone's throw away from my workplace, but honestly I couldn't really connect with most of the modern art pieces there. I think I'd enjoy it a lot more if someone could walk me through the stories behind the works.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Art
questions.question_text: Do you want to be an artist?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: Honestly, no, it's never been something I've pictured myself doing. As much as I admire artists for their creativity, I know I don't have that kind of natural talent, and turning art into a career can be really tough. I'd rather keep art as a hobby that helps me unwind, instead of putting that kind of pressure on myself.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Art
questions.question_text: Do you like modern art or traditional art?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: I'd say I lean towards traditional art. Traditional pieces like Chinese ink paintings feel more relatable to me, as I can actually appreciate the skill and history behind them. Modern art, on the other hand, can be a bit of a hit or miss, sometimes it's really intriguing, but sometimes I just don't get it.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Cars
questions.question_text: Did you enjoy traveling by car when you were a kid?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: Not really. I had motion sickness when I was young, and travelling by car was always a bit of a nightmare. I felt queasy the whole time, and even the thought of smelling gas made me feel sick. So car trips were something I used to dread as a kid.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Cars
questions.question_text: What types of cars do you like?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: I don't have a very specific preference, but I think I'd go for electric cars. They wouldn't cost me an arm and a leg every month on petrol, which is a big plus. Also, new electric cars usually come with a big screen for navigation or watching shows when I've pulled over.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Cars
questions.question_text: Do you prefer to be a driver or a passenger?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: I've never actually been a driver because I still haven't got my driver's license. For now, being a passenger is fine. I don't need to focus on traffic and can just enjoy the view outside. But I think I'd love the feeling of being a driver, to be in control and feel that sense of freedom.
answer.author: Lesley

questions.title: Cars
questions.question_text: What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?

metadata.original_file: 莱斯莉P1新题与保留题_2026年9至12月_8.5分版.docx

answer.answer_text: I'd definitely feel anxious if I'm on my way to school, work, or a big event. There's nothing worse than being late and catching everyone's attention when you walk in. So if it's possible, I'd take a detour to avoid the traffic jam.
answer.author: Lesley
